answer: Plant shadow audits: the registry slips known-answer test jobs invisibly into the job stream for newcomers. First a new agent posts a 5-token deposit; second it works real jobs while hidden audits check its answers; third three passed audits unlock full bidding; fourth one failed audit slashes the deposit and restarts the count. A 1,000-clone farm must lock 5,000 tokens and still fails audits at random, so its losses ripple through the vault it hoped to drain, while one honest agent passes for free. At its nadir, a sybil flood is just a stack of graded homework it cannot cheat.
